{"item_id": "podcast:https://www.rokslide.com/?p=29810", "version_id": "b72bd34adcc4b6911e3e801455d7eaa6fea305b1cadd452c3f94141b7921aabd", "decision": "defer", "reason": "Relevant gear content (Peak Refuel meals, KUIU Icon 6 pack, Patagonia Nano Air Ultralight jacket, Lathrop super-wide boots) under the Relevance section, but most claims rest on single-reviewer or sponsor-adjacent testimony: Peak Refuel's Haley Reeves is a brand representative making calorie and shelf-life claims, Lathrop & Sons is a long-term boot sponsor of Rockslide with its own HSA pitch, and the Icon 6 and Nano Air reviews are individual field impressions without a second independent publisher, so the Commercial incentives and Credibility sections make the evidence too thin to rely on yet. Under Unsupported claims, the Icon 6 durability and Peak meal claims are manufacturer statements, and the episode also contains multiple sponsor reads (Onyx Hunt, Maven, Tenacity, Mattson's Lab, Mule Deer Foundation) and a non-gear political segment on Colorado Amendment 83 that is out of scope.", "piece_ids": []}
{"item_id": "podcast:huntbackcountry.podbean.com/d9e12821-70f0-3d9b-8475-5a569ae5530f", "version_id": "35697010ceefae0df17bfe2aa16730cb71c03b46fb864f8ad9a141eae1715aa9", "decision": "defer", "reason": "Relevant practitioner gear Q&A covering base layers, synthetic and down insulation, wet-weather moisture management, Hanwag and Mindel boots, metatarsal insoles, and phone cases under the Relevance and Credibility sections, but the source is run by Exo Mtn Gear, a pack maker, and the host's claims on gear performance come from a single 10-day Alaska trip with no independent testing or second publisher, so per the Commercial incentives and Freshness rules the evidence is too thin to rely on yet. The host's assertions that he has no affiliation with brands are self-reported, and several product claims (Mindel boot durability, the metatarsal insole fix for Morton's neuroma, the Argali merino hoodie) are individual experience rather than corroborated findings. Under Unsupported claims, the Morton's neuroma and sharpening advice are personal and unverified, and the episode should be reconsidered if stronger independent or multi-publisher evidence appears.", "piece_ids": []}
